items.title: Healthcare cost inflation is back in the headlines
items.summary: The shock to global trade risks triggering a sustained period of higher medical inflation while cost-of-living crises threaten healthcare affordability.

items.title: Validation to velocity: Japan’s pharma model comes under execution pressure
items.summary: Japan’s pharmaceutical sector is gradually reorienting from deep, validation-led development towards execution-driven partnerships, as global pressure compresses timelines across drug development.

items.title: California startup Protuoso raises $9.5m for “mix-and-match” drug platform
items.summary: The US biotech’s technology integrates multiple protein modalities to simultaneously target a variety of disease mechanisms.

items.title: Kardigan targets IPO to support cardiology pipeline progression
items.summary: Kardigan plans to use the IPO funds to push its three in-licensed, mid-to-late-stage heart health therapies down the clinical pipeline.

items.title: Autobahn’s elunetirom receives FDA fast track designation to treat adjunctive bipolar
items.summary: Autobahn Therapeutics has received fast track designation from the FDA for elunetirom, its lead CNS-directed thyroid hormone receptor agonist.
